nvitk.db.filters¶

Declarative table filters: normalize user specs to conditions, apply on DataFrames, or compile SQL.

Used by DataRepo and SQLiteIndex.

nvitk.db.filters._is_multi_value(value: Any) → bool¶

True if value is a sequence type (list/tuple/set/…) rather than a scalar filter value.

nvitk.db.filters._normalize_op(op: str) → str¶

Normalize a filter operator string/alias ($gte, >=, isnull, …) to its canonical name; raises FilterError if it doesn’t resolve to a supported op.

nvitk.db.filters.normalize_filters(filters: Mapping[str, Any] | None) → dict[str, list[FilterCondition]]¶

Turn API filter dicts into column → list of FilterCondition.

Values may be scalars (eq), sequences (in), None (is_null), mappings of {$op: value}, or FilterCondition instances.

nvitk.db.filters._mask_for_condition(series: pandas.Series, condition: FilterCondition) → pandas.Series¶

Boolean mask over series selecting rows that satisfy condition (equality, comparison, membership, null checks, or substring containment).

nvitk.db.filters.apply_filters(df: pandas.DataFrame, filters: Mapping[str, Any] | None) → pandas.DataFrame¶

AND-combine normalized filters; pipeline_version maps to pipeline_id when needed.

nvitk.db.filters.escape_identifier(identifier: str) → str¶

Double-quote an SQL identifier (internal use for parameterized queries).

nvitk.db.filters.build_sql_where(filters: Mapping[str, Any] | None) → tuple[str, list[Any]]¶

Build a WHERE fragment and positional parameters for the SQLite index.

Returns ("", []) when filters is empty or None.

nvitk.db.filters.merge_filters(*filters: Mapping[str, Any] | None) → dict[str, Any]¶

Shallow-merge dicts left to right; skips None.

Normalize a single string or iterable of strings to a list of str (empty if None).
